newsitem.title: USA: Western Pacific May load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Western Pacific May load factor rises.

text.p: Western Pacific Airlines Inc on Tuesday said its passenger load factor in May increased 9.2 percentage points to 65.6 percent compared with the same month of 1996.
May 1997 revenue passenger miles increased 42 percent to 169,566,900 from 118,665,000 in the same period last year, Western Pacific said.
Available seat miles increased 22.8 percent to 258,418,000 from 210,484,400.
Western Pacfic's load factor for the first five months of 1997 fell 2.5 percentage points to 55 percent from 57.5 percent in the same period of 1996, the carrier said.
